items.reason: Matches the unchanged Redis key namespace switching from sets to sorted sets without migration, causing WRONGTYPE failures during insertion and flushing.
Matches default SUM aggregation in ZUNIONSTORE doubling duplicate payload timestamp scores and incorrectly protecting old spans from eviction.

Matches the incompatible Redis type change under existing buffer keys, causing WRONGTYPE failures during rollout. The additional old-worker incompatibility detail describes the same migration problem.
Matches ZUNIONSTORE summing duplicate payload timestamp scores, causing replayed old spans to survive eviction ahead of newer spans.
Matches default SUM aggregation on overlapping sorted sets inflating timestamp scores and breaking oldest-first eviction.
Matches removal of the flush-time span-count guard leaving max_segment_spans unenforced while Lua uses a hardcoded cap of 1000.
